codeReview.summary: The round2 fix resolves the prior blocker. `ScenePainter` now prepares native glyphs without writing the atlas, computes the exact post-crop `glyphRect` from the preview entry, and only calls `commitPreparedGlyph` after that final clip test passes. That closes the padding-only-intersection hole left by the first fix, and the updated VAL-TEXT-010 regression explicitly covers both fully clipped and padding-only native-text cases.

summary: Reviewed the prior failed reviews, both feature handoffs and transcript skeletons, the graphics-scene skill, shared-state docs, and commits `02bb6a44f080eb3e51d1ef8355376d2b52186710` and `a54f9049c4aa1c8cf91933f6b993f605483f21e5`. The new prepare/commit split in `NativeGlyphAtlas` and the final exact-bounds clip gate in `ScenePainter` prevent atlas dirtying when only padded bounds intersect the clip, so this rerun adequately resolves the earlier scrutiny failure.
